all128NonzeroQuickGates.scope: all 128 type-potential candidates for each c in {-1,+1}

boundedFamily.exhaustiveScope: Exactly c in {-1,0,+1} for R2 and the six sealed representatives; the sealed identity/w6/tau equivalence expands this to the 72 pairs on the old 24-candidate survivor frontier.
boundedFamily.scopeWarning: Because c*R2 precedes p_w, the 104 candidates eliminated by earlier c=0 chamber or maximal-type-5 gates can be resurrected when c is nonzero. All 256 nonzero pairs were therefore rescanned at the chamber and five-type rank-four gates; 40 resurrected pairs remain open.

conclusion.all128QuickGates: Across the complete 128-by-3 product, the old c=0 pipeline and the new c=+/-1 chamber plus five-type rank-four gates eliminate exactly 344 pairs and leave 40 open; every open pair is resurrected from outside the old 24 frontier.
conclusion.boundedFamily: No member of the old 24-candidate survivor frontier, for any c in {-1,0,+1}, survives the rank-four full-star gate.
conclusion.nonClaim: The 40 open pairs have not passed a maximal-type-5 scan or the remaining 51 spherical central types, so this is not a Track B fibering result or a closure of the full R2 product. It also does not eliminate other periodic cell coordinates, coefficient families, or primitive characters.
conclusion.oldMotifs: c=+1 connects all six certified old obstruction motifs; c=0 reproduces the sealed closure and c=-1 does not repair them.
conclusion.positiveCoefficient: c=+1 passes every compressed original-chamber root but all six representatives fail at new exact rank-four roots.

maximalType5Gate.reason: The old 24-candidate frontier needs no further gate, but 40 resurrected all-128 product pairs passed the chamber and five-type rank-four gates. Their exact maximal-type-5 workload is evaluated separately before any bounded run.

periodicCoordinate.definition: For a rooted Coxeter cell C=xW_T, Ua(C) is the full-fiber average |W_T|^-1 sum_{y in xW_T} (-1)^t_a(y), and R2(C)=-U0(C)*(1-U2(C)^2).
periodicCoordinate.exactIntegerFormula: If N=|W_T| and na=sum_y (-1)^t_a(y), then R2=-n0*(N^2-n2^2)/N^3; every comparison uses exact integer cross-products.

globalCompatibility.characterUnchanged: Adding a bounded quotient-periodic 0-cochain changes the lifted height by a periodic coboundary, not its primitive deck character.
globalCompatibility.faceCompatible: R2 is one value on every barycentric cell vertex; the canonical affine extension on each barycentric simplex therefore agrees on shared faces.
globalCompatibility.nonzeroEarlierTiersPreserved: R2 is compared only after exact raw and U0 ties.
globalCompatibility.quotientPeriodic: K translations preserve U0; they may negate U2 but preserve U2^2. L maps full fibers bijectively and preserves the merged-color voltage data.
globalCompatibility.tauBehavior: tau(t,q)=(t xor e0,q) negates U0 and R2, fixes U2^2, and transfers a restricted-negation candidate by swapping ascending and descending links.
globalCompatibility.unrootedCellWellDefined: Changing x inside xW_T permutes the complete W_T fiber.

periodicCoordinate.name: R2
periodicCoordinate.noDiscreteRangeClaim: U2 and R2 are exact rationals on general fibers; the calculation does not restrict them to {-1,0,+1}.

resourceBounds.policy: stop on the first disconnected directed link per pair
resourceBounds.verificationPolicy: Generation enforces the five-minute search cap. Exact --verify replay has no wall-clock failure condition, so host contention cannot invalidate a sealed certificate.
